weights.role: last epoch; element-wise identical to best on the golden sample

preprocess.color_convert: BGR -> RGB after padding, before scaling
preprocess.layout: HWC -> CHW, add batch axis, float32

channels.0:8: raw keypoint offsets: (dx,dy) x 4 corners, order TL,TR,BR,BL
channels.8: colour logit z; p_red = sigmoid(z), colour_p = [1 - p_red, p_red] = [p_blue, p_red]
channels.9:16: role logits r[0..6]; role_p = sigmoid(r), 7 INDEPENDENT probabilities (multi-label, NOT softmax)

anchors.order: level-major, then row-major inside a level (x varies fastest)
anchors.center: (x + 0.5, y + 0.5) in grid units, x in [0, w), y in [0, h)

decode.bbox: xyxy = (min(kpt_x), min(kpt_y), max(kpt_x), max(kpt_y)) over the 4 decoded corners (no DFL box, no objectness)
decode.class_scores: score[c * 7 + r] = colour_p[c] * role_p[r], c in {0:blue, 1:red}, r in 0..6
decode.best_class: argmax over all 14 scores; conf = max score

postprocess.nms: class-aware greedy NMS on xyxy boxes, scores sorted descending (same as ultralytics non_max_suppression with multi_label=False)
postprocess.cross_class_note: different colours of the same plate are NOT suppressed by class-aware NMS and can appear as two detections; dedupe by IoU if the consumer requires one box per plate
postprocess.coordinate_unmap: x_orig = (x_net - pad_left) / r, y_orig = (y_net - pad_top) / r
postprocess.box_clip: clip final xyxy to [0, image_w] x [0, image_h]; keypoints are left unclipped

keypoints.meaning: four corners of the armor plate in image coordinates (x right, y down)

known_limitations: The colour branch is currently unreliable: ~54.5-59.4% colour accuracy on held-out workspaces (vs 99.86% for the previous v3 model). Role classification is healthy (~92.8% on matched detections).
Role outputs are independent sigmoids; do not softmax them and do not renormalise.
There is no objectness channel. Confidence is colour_p * role_p; do not look for a separate objectness row.
Do not feed this model to the old raw18 C++ decoders (OUTPUT_ATTRIBUTE_COUNT=18, objectness at row 8, 2-colour softmax, 7-way role softmax). They are semantically incompatible.
Fixed input 480x640, fixed batch 1. Re-export if another size/batch is required.
